page.layout: One printed page of text: running verse in two-line stanzas, with verse numbers 14 to 22 in the left margin, beside the lines they belong to. Running head and page number at the top. Signature at the bottom right. At the far right, the edge of the neighbouring page, not transcribed.

main_text.p: 14 Concidit Herodis Baptista furore peremptus. Panibus exiguis millia multa cibat.
Calcat aquas CHRISTUS, Petrus sed mente vacillat. A variis multos liberat inde malis.
15 Humanae culpat rationis dogmata falsa. Et quae sint, hominem quae violare queant.

p.i: Voti compos abit Chananaeae gentis alumna.

main_text.p: 16 Signa petunt, prohibet fermentum gentis iniquae. Et CHRISTUM sancto praedicat ore Petrus. Dat claves: mortem praedicit: praemia quae sint Sanctorum, & fidei munera digna docet.
17 Transformat vultum clara sub imagine CHRISTUS Quem nequeunt alii liberat ille virum. Tristia praedicit mox mortis fata futura. Nummum sub patulo gutture piscis habet.
18 Quis maior docet heic, prohibetque offendere parvos. Nam CHRISTUS nostra causa salutis adest. Candona fratri quae in te delicta notavit, Hoc gravis accepti summa remissa docet.
19 Coniugii quae sit ratio & quae cura pudoris, Et quae sit pueris gratia danda docet. Quae via sit vitae, quam vix adit omnis abundans Divitiis, & quae praemia danda piis.
20 Agricolas plures conducit, tristia fata Narrat, pro natis mater inepta rogat. Quis vere magnus? reliquis qui rite ministrat. Accepto caeci lumine cuncta vident.

21 Ingreditur Solymas cunctanti vectus asella: Expurgat templum: paruula turba canit. Fit sterilis ficus, faciat cur talia quaerunt. Iudaicae gentis pectora dura notat. Occidunt servos Domini, fera fata subibunt. Perdere non audent, quem periisse velint.
22 Eiicitur thalamis impura veste prophanus, Caesaris & quae sunt reddere rite iubet. Denuo confurgent defuncti: maxima quae sit Lex docet, & David mystica verba canit.

page.notes: The verse numbers 14 to 22 in the left margin belong to the stanzas beside them and are kept in the text. Roman small capitals (CHRISTUS) are copied in capitals, and V is changed to U as a vowel. The mark at the foot of the page right of centre ("23" beside "Va") looks like a manuscript or catalogue mark rather than print; it is left out, and the signature is doubtful. The running head is cut off at the right edge and may continue beyond "EVANG". The right-hand strip shows the edge of the neighbouring page, with fragments of verse and a heading ("VERSVS", "GEMMA"), and is not transcribed. The small ornament beside line 15 and the small pen mark near the top are not print and are left out.
